## Summary

Describe the problem and the chosen solution.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation reflects user-visible changes.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated when appropriate.
- [ ] No credentials, private source, generated caches, or metrics are included.
- [ ] The change preserves host-specific hook contracts and fail-open behavior.

## Compatibility

- [ ] Cursor

- [ ] Platform-independent / not applicable

## Additional context

Link related issues and note follow-up work or known tradeoffs.
